method: Paged through the entire local api-v3 VA 2026 corpus (3,637 bills, per_page=20, 182 pages, include=votes) and checked every vote dated 2026-02-17 for Elizabeth B. Bennett-Parker's presence in the per-voter voter_name list. Local-only scan -- no live API calls (would exceed useful rate-limit budget to check all 338 individually); a separate random 8-bill sample of the newly-found bills (i.e. excluding the ~20 originally sampled) was then checked against live directly, see va_open26_sample8_live_verify.json.
non_bennett_parker_2026-02-17_votes_are_: all 72 non-BP bills' same-day votes are Senate floor votes (40 voters) or House committee votes (15-22 voters) -- different chamber/committee, not part of the House floor block-vote this finding is about. Sample of 10 shown below for reference.
